```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 03_central_tendency_median
title: >
  Median and ordinal data
questions:
  - id: ordinal_median
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      Six customers give ordered satisfaction responses. The two middle responses
      are neutral and satisfied. What is the most appropriate way to describe the
      median?
    options:
      - text: Between neutral and satisfied
        correct: true
      - text: The average of the category codes
      - text: Whichever response is more common
      - text: No median
    explanation: >
      The responses can be ordered, so their middle positions are meaningful
      even though the variable is categorical. But there is no defined halfway
      amount between neutral and satisfied: averaging category codes would assume
      equal gaps. Any convention for resolving that boundary should be stated.
```
